scope: Lever 3 measured retained channel-margin counteraxis readout. It selects a strict-positive score-margin buffer over frozen train/cal source-free channel scores and then selects a fold-nearest-atlas TM midband over the same frozen channel surface, followed by a high-fold/low-geometry-cofactor pressure rule. All stages exclude retained application rows from rule selection and apply the selected rules only after selection. It changes no thresholds, scores no new rows, stages no coordinates, and uses no heldout rows.
